item.title: Courier Management System SQLI Vulnerability
item.description:
SQL Injection Vulnerability in itsourcecode Courier Management System V1.0

BUG_Author: liuhanzhi Affected Version: V1.0 Vendor: itsourcecode Software: Courier Management System Vulnerability File:

  • /manage_user.php

Description

1. SQL Injection via id Parameter

In the file /manage_user.php, the application directly concatenates the user-supplied id parameter into an SQL query without any sanitization or validation.

Vulnerable code (line 5):

$user = $conn->query("SELECT * FROM users where id =".$_GET['id']);

2. Exploiting the SQL Injection

By injecting malicious SQL commands into the id parameter via a GET request, an attacker can manipulate the underlying SQL query to perform unauthorized database operations including data extraction, modification, and enumeration.

item.title: short_videos ssrf Vulnerability
item.description:
Title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability in short_videos via api/svproxyurl.php

BUG_Author: liuhanzhi

Affected Version: short_videos (latest unpatched version as of 2026-04-29)

Vendor: short_videos GitHub Repository

Software: short_videos

Vulnerability Files:

  • api/svproxyurl.php

Description:

  1. Unauthenticated SSRF / Open Proxy in api/svproxyurl.php:

    • In api/svproxyurl.php, the application accepts a user-controlled proxyurl parameter from $_GET or $_POST.
    • The value is decoded by base64_decode() and then passed directly into CURLOPT_URL inside both weibo_proxy() and douyin_proxy().
    • No authentication, host allowlist, private-network restriction, or redirect target validation is implemented.

item.title: Watermark removal management system vul_1
item.description:
Title: Unauthorized Database Operation Vulnerability in Ludashi Watermark Removal Management System

BUG_Author: liuhanzhi

Affected Version: Watermark removal management system ≤ 4.0

Vendor: Standalone Watermark Removal Mini Program

Software: Ludashi Watermark Removal Management System Download Link

Vulnerability Files:

  • admin/ajax.php

Description:

  1. Unauthorized database write operations:

    • Deobfuscate the obfuscated code in /admin/ajax.php, click to download the anti-obfuscation code.

    • In /admin/ajax.php, the interface dispatches a large amount of add/delete/update logic through the act parameter.

    • No effective backend session authentication and authorization logic is found in the file, so attackers can directly invoke sensitive operations without logging in.
